# M-Elevadores — llms.txt
# Chilean elevator and accessibility solutions company
# https://www.melevadores.cl

> M-Elevadores SpA specializes in stairlifts, platform lifts, elevators, and elevator modernization in Chile. Certified under Ley 20.296 MINVU. 25+ years of experience. Free technical visits throughout Chile.

## Main Pages

- [Inicio](https://www.melevadores.cl/): Homepage with product catalog overview and services
- [Catálogo](https://www.melevadores.cl/catalogo): Full product catalog — 12 products across 5 categories
- [Salvaescaleras](https://www.melevadores.cl/catalogo/salvaescaleras): Stairlift category page — straight and curved models
- [Guía de Compra](https://www.melevadores.cl/guia-de-compra): Interactive product recommendation guide
- [Testimonios](https://www.melevadores.cl/testimonios): Customer testimonials — 4,000+ installations
- [Nosotros](https://www.melevadores.cl/nosotros): Company information, history, certifications

## Product Catalog

### Salvaescaleras (Stairlifts)
- [Salvaescaleras Recto SOLO](https://www.melevadores.cl/catalogo/salvaescaleras-recto-solo): Straight stairlift. 125 kg capacity. 1-day installation. Folds to 28 cm. For straight staircases up to 14 m.

### Plataformas Elevadoras (Platform Lifts)
- [Plataforma Vertical DIGNITY](https://www.melevadores.cl/catalogo/plataforma-vertical-dignity): Vertical wheelchair platform. 400 kg, 90×140 cm. NCh3271 certified. Interior and exterior.
- [Plataforma Inclinada ACCESS](https://www.melevadores.cl/catalogo/plataforma-inclinada-access): Inclined stair platform. 300 kg. Foldable. For schools, churches, public buildings. Ley 20.422 compliant.

### Ascensores (Elevators)
- [Ascensor Residencial HOME](https://www.melevadores.cl/catalogo/ascensor-residencial-home): Home elevator. 400 kg (~5 persons). No pit required (6 cm prep). 4 stops. 2-3 week installation.
- [Ascensor Condominio TOWER](https://www.melevadores.cl/catalogo/ascensor-condominio-tower): Residential building elevator. 630–1,600 kg. 25 stops. 24/7 monitoring app. Ley 20.296 certified.
- [Ascensor Comercial PRIME](https://www.melevadores.cl/catalogo/ascensor-comercial-prime): Commercial elevator. Up to 2,500 kg. 4 m/s. Destination control system. ISO 25745 Class A.
- [Ascensor Panorámico VIEW](https://www.melevadores.cl/catalogo/ascensor-panoramico-view): Panoramic glass elevator. 630–1,600 kg. 5 shaft configurations. For hotels and corporate buildings.
- [Ascensor Camilla MED](https://www.melevadores.cl/catalogo/ascensor-camilla-med): Hospital/stretcher elevator. 1,600–2,000 kg. Wide door opening. For clinics and hospitals.
- [Ascensor Residencial VILLA](https://www.melevadores.cl/catalogo/ascensor-residencial-villa): Luxury home elevator. IoT app. Panoramic option. SHV3000/SHV5000 series for villas and lofts.

### Escaleras Mecánicas (Escalators)
- [Escalera Mecánica GRE](https://www.melevadores.cl/catalogo/escalera-mecanica-gre): Commercial escalator. Up to 7.9 m rise. 3 inclinations. Indoor/outdoor. 16 hr/day operation.

### Modernización (Modernization)
- [Modernización RE-PLUS](https://www.melevadores.cl/catalogo/modernizacion-replus): Full elevator modernization. Any brand. Up to 45% energy savings. Ley 20.296 certification included.
- [Decoración de Cabina DECO](https://www.melevadores.cl/catalogo/decoracion-cabina-deco): Aesthetic cabin renovation. 1-3 days. No mechanical work. Any brand. LCD panels, LED lighting.
